_comment: Durable record of the shared Abacus download counters.
Automatically synchronized by GitHub Actions and served to every visitor
as a same-origin fallback when Abacus is unreachable.
Shape: { namespace, updatedAt, visitors, files: { "apps/Name.pdf": { downloads, key } } }.
Counts only ever move upwards: syncs keep the larger of the saved and
live Abacus values. Entries for removed files are retained.
